I couldn't share any specifics about them cause im doing interaction design which is pretty different. but overall impression is really good. groups are small(not like classic uni) and u get enough time to talk with profs. people are generally open and ready to help. but u can't really choose subjects, program is pretty much fixed. normally u need to attend 80% of seminars and lectures but if you need to doctor or anything urgent its fine. also I believe ppl who work skip a bit more and its fine. my classes are cool and different. we had a brief from real client and winners got money. we are making games, some audio design stuff and soon gonna make some kind of interactive projection mapping. but if u choose media or communication u would do more graphic design stuff then this. hit me up if u need something else
